# PlainBTC

> Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news and beginner guides. Official site: https://plainbtc.com

## English

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/): Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news, market recaps, and beginner guides for U.S. readers. Updated November 2026.
- [About PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/about): What PlainBTC is: plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news for beginners, with clear disclosures and no financial advice.
- [Affiliate & referral disclosure](https://plainbtc.com/disclosure): FTC-compliant affiliate disclosure for PlainBTC: Coinbase, Gemini, and River referral links on English pages, Uphold on Spanish and Portuguese pages, and not financial advice.
- [Monero falls about 11% after KuCoin says it will delist XMR on Nov. 30](https://plainbtc.com/articles/monero-falls-11-percent-kucoin-delists-xmr-nov-2026): Monero fell more than 11% on Thursday after KuCoin said it will delist XMR on Nov. 30, weeks after MEXC did the same. KuCoin users have until Dec. 31 to withdraw. EU rules that start in July 2027 are pushing regulated platforms away from privacy coins.
- [Binance says withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after its $6.3 billion hack](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-withdrawals-fully-restored-after-6-3-billion-hack-nov-2026): Binance says the withdrawal suspension from its Oct. 29 hack is fully lifted, ending a four-week phased restart. A small number of networks remain paused for maintenance that the exchange says is unrelated. It also warned about scammers offering to "speed up withdrawals."
- [NovaTech founders ordered to pay $1.37 billion over crypto Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian families](https://plainbtc.com/articles/novatech-founders-ordered-to-pay-1-37-billion-new-york-crypto-ponzi-nov-2026): A New York court ordered NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion to pay about $1.37 billion for a crypto Ponzi scheme aimed at Haitian immigrant families. The couple fled the country and never answered the case, so victims may wait a long time for any money.
- [Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody reports data breach, the third crypto security scare this week](https://plainbtc.com/articles/zodia-custody-data-breach-cryptio-bithumb-phishing-nov-2026): Zodia Custody, Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, says an outsider accessed limited client and staff contact data, with no unauthorized transactions. It is one of three crypto security disclosures this week, alongside Cryptio and Bithumb. The main risk for customers now is phishing.
- [Bill to lock U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years reaches the full House, but time is short](https://plainbtc.com/articles/house-strategic-bitcoin-reserve-bill-20-year-lock-floor-vote-nov-2026): A bill that would make the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve permanent law and ban selling its coins for at least 20 years is now eligible for a House vote. No date is set, Congress ends on Jan. 3, and Polymarket puts the odds of a reserve law this year at about 4%.
- [Fake internet routes tricked over 1,000 bitcoin mining sites into working for an attacker, Braiins says](https://plainbtc.com/articles/braiins-hashrate-hijacking-stratum-v1-1000-mining-sites-nov-2026): Braiins says an attacker hijacked internet routes to send bitcoin miners on the old, unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol to a fake pool. On Nov. 20, more than 1,000 sites at a time were diverted, with up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power. Braiins urges an upgrade to Stratum V2.
- [Bitcoin climbs back above $60,000 on Thanksgiving as spot bitcoin ETFs log a seventh straight day of outflows](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-back-above-60000-thanksgiving-etf-outflows-seventh-day-nov-2026): Bitcoin was back near $60,800 on Thanksgiving morning, about 6% above Wednesday's low near $57,200 on Kraken. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $453 million on Wednesday, their seventh straight day of outflows, and November withdrawals now total about $5.39 billion.
- [Fidelity files for a spot Chainlink ETF that would trade on Nasdaq as FLNK and would not stake its LINK](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fidelity-files-spot-chainlink-etf-flnk-nov-2026): Fidelity filed with the SEC on Nov. 25 to launch a spot Chainlink ETF. The Fidelity Chainlink Fund would hold LINK directly and trade on Nasdaq as FLNK, but it would not stake its tokens, and the filing leaves the fee and launch date blank.
- [Coinbase Wallet now takes paychecks by direct deposit and turns them into USDC on Base, up to $3,000 per deposit](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coinbase-wallet-direct-deposit-paycheck-usdc-base-nov-2026): Coinbase Wallet launched direct deposit for eligible U.S. users. You get account and routing numbers for your payroll, and your pay arrives as USDC on the Base network at a 1 to 1 rate, with no Coinbase deposit fee. Limits are $3,000 per deposit and $10,000 per day.
- [Franklin Templeton's crypto index ETF will add Hyperliquid's HYPE on Dec. 1, its eighth coin next to bitcoin and ether](https://plainbtc.com/articles/franklin-templeton-ezpz-etf-adds-hyperliquid-hype-nov-2026): Franklin Templeton's Franklin Crypto Index ETF (EZPZ) will add Hyperliquid's HYPE token on or about Dec. 1, 2026, according to a Nov. 25 SEC filing. The fund will then hold eight coins. As of Sept. 30 it had about $17 million in net assets, with bitcoin at 76.39%.
- [DOJ says its largest-ever scam crackdown hit 800+ defendants, and crypto investment fraud was a top target](https://plainbtc.com/articles/doj-scam-crackdown-800-defendants-1-billion-crypto-frozen-nov-2026): The U.S. Justice Department says its anti-scam surge since March 6 led to action in more than 400 cases against more than 800 defendants. Crypto investment fraud from Southeast Asian scam centers was a main target, and U.S.-backed police there froze more than $1 billion in stolen crypto.
- [Nvidia agrees to pay $290 million to settle investor lawsuit over crypto mining sales from the 2017-2018 boom](https://plainbtc.com/articles/nvidia-290-million-settlement-crypto-mining-lawsuit-nov-2026): Nvidia agreed to pay $290 million to settle a shareholder class action claiming it played down how much of its gaming chip sales came from crypto miners before the 2018 crypto crash. Lawyers filed the deal on Nov. 24; a federal judge in California still has to approve it.
- [Bitcoin slides to $58,000 as the Fed's favorite inflation gauge hits 3.8%, on track for an eighth straight weekly loss](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-58000-pce-inflation-3-8-percent-eighth-weekly-loss-nov-2026): Bitcoin dropped to about $58,000 on Wednesday after October PCE inflation came in at 3.8%, with core prices a bit hotter than forecast. Stock futures slid on reports of new U.S. tariffs, spot bitcoin ETFs lost money for a sixth day, and bitcoin is down about 25% in November.
- [Crypto app Bullpen says a hacker took over 19 old beta accounts, draining about $2.57 million from trader Ansem's imported wallet](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bullpen-hack-ansem-wallet-2-57-million-imported-keys-nov-2026): Bullpen, a crypto trading app, says an attacker took over 19 accounts from its 2024 beta, including that of co-founder and trader Ansem, and drained wallets whose private keys were imported into the app. About $2.57 million moved, ANSEM fell about 55%, and Bullpen has shut the old system down.
- [Fidelity Crypto adds Aave, Chainlink and Uniswap, its first DeFi tokens, as the three coins slide about 23% to 32% in a month](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fidelity-crypto-adds-aave-link-uni-nov-2026): Fidelity added Aave, Chainlink and Uniswap tokens to Fidelity Crypto and its crypto IRAs, its first decentralized finance (DeFi) tokens. The platform now lists seven coins plus its FIDD stablecoin, charges a 1% trading fee, and excludes Oregon for the new tokens. All three are down sharply over the past month.
- [Coldcard maker publishes postmortem: weak recovery phrases let thieves take about 1,779 BTC, and no device was hacked](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coldcard-postmortem-weak-seeds-bitcoin-thefts-nov-2026): Coinkite published its postmortem on the Coldcard seed flaw: from March 2021 to July 2026 the wallets built recovery phrases with a weak software generator, and thieves recreated keys offline. Galaxy Research counted about 1,779 BTC stolen. Updating firmware does not fix an old seed; owners must move funds to a new one.
- [Kraken's Krak opens a waitlist for U.S. credit cards with up to 4% bitcoin cashback, including one secured by USDC](https://plainbtc.com/articles/kraken-krak-credit-cards-4-percent-bitcoin-cashback-usdc-secured-nov-2026): Kraken parent Payward's Krak app opened a waitlist for two U.S. Visa credit cards that pay up to 4% cashback in dollars or bitcoin. The secured version uses $350 to $5,000 in USDC as collateral. Both need a Krakpass membership, ship in early 2027, and still have no published interest rates or fees.
- [Bitcoin ETFs set a monthly outflow record: $4.71 billion out in November as bitcoin slips back to $60,000](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-etfs-record-4-71-billion-november-outflows-nov-2026): U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $569.7 million on Monday, their fifth losing day in a row, and November outflows reached a record $4.71 billion. Bitcoin dipped to about $59,300 on Kraken overnight and traded near $60,000 Tuesday morning.
- [South Korea's crypto bill: bank-led won stablecoins, legal coin offerings and a 20% cap on exchange owners](https://plainbtc.com/articles/south-korea-crypto-bill-bank-led-stablecoins-ico-20-percent-exchange-cap-nov-2026): South Korea's financial regulator released a draft crypto law: won stablecoins only from consortia that are more than 50% bank-owned, domestic coin offerings with a filed white paper, a 20% cap on exchange shareholders and no-fault liability for hacks. It now goes to the National Assembly.
- [Bitcoin jumps to $64,500 on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, then gives it all back as stocks soar](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-spikes-to-64500-on-huang-return-then-fades-nov-2026): Bitcoin jumped from about $61,000 to $64,520 on Kraken after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, then slipped back to about $61,200 by evening. The Nasdaq closed up 6.51% and Nvidia rose about 32%, but bitcoin ended the day almost flat.
- [CFTC staff say exchanges and clearinghouses can count bitcoin, ether and stablecoins toward their reserves](https://plainbtc.com/articles/cftc-staff-bitcoin-ether-stablecoins-count-toward-exchange-reserves-nov-2026): CFTC staff said regulated derivatives exchanges and clearinghouses may count bitcoin, ether and payment stablecoins toward the reserves that must cover 12 months of operating costs, after haircuts of at least 20% for BTC and ETH and 2% for stablecoins. Crypto still cannot count as cash.
- [Binance hires Mandiant, SlowMist and Verichains to check its security after the $6.3 billion hack](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-hires-mandiant-slowmist-verichains-security-review-nov-2026): Binance hired three outside security firms, Mandiant, SlowMist and Verichains, to review its security procedures after the Oct. 29 hack of about $6.3 billion. The exchange says it will act on their findings, but it has not said when the reviews will finish or whether results will be made public.
- [ARK Invest drops plans for two CoinDesk 20 crypto ETFs as the bear market drags on](https://plainbtc.com/articles/ark-invest-withdraws-coindesk-20-crypto-etfs-nov-2026): ARK Invest asked the SEC on Nov. 20 to withdraw two planned crypto ETFs tied to the CoinDesk 20 index, including a version that strips out bitcoin. Neither fund ever launched. Bitcoin is down about a third since ARK filed in January.
- [Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.79 billion in a week, their fourth straight week of outflows](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-etfs-1-79-billion-weekly-outflow-fourth-week-nov-2026): U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost a net $1.79 billion from Nov. 16 to 20, the fourth losing week in a row and the biggest since June. BlackRock's IBIT lost $544.7 million on Friday alone, a new one-day record. Bitcoin bounced to about $62,900 on Monday.
- [Strategy buys 457 more bitcoin but spends seven times as much buying back its STRC shares](https://plainbtc.com/articles/strategy-buys-457-bitcoin-212-million-strc-buyback-nov-2026): Strategy bought 457 bitcoin for $29.6 million last week and now holds 851,305 BTC at an average cost of $75,446. It spent far more, $211.8 million, buying back its STRC preferred shares, and raised that buyback program from $3 billion to $4 billion.
- [Fusionist bridge hack: attacker mints 10 quintillion fake ACE tokens, traders drain $3.7 million](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fusionist-ace-bridge-exploit-10-quintillion-tokens-nov-2026): An attacker minted about 10 quintillion unbacked ACE tokens on BNB Chain on Sunday and sold them for about $2 million. Traders then used the cheap fakes to drain the bridge's 53.7 million real ACE, worth about $3.7 million.
- [Trump hosts second memecoin dinner as the TRUMP token trades near record lows](https://plainbtc.com/articles/trump-memecoin-second-dinner-token-down-99-percent-nov-2026): Trump hosts the top 185 TRUMP memecoin holders on Sunday, Nov. 22. The token trades near $0.88, close to Saturday's record low of $0.798 on Kraken and about 99% below its January 2025 peak.

Trackers say wallets labeled as Abraxas Capital withdrew 17,597 BTC, about $1.04 billion, from Binance and Kraken during the dip.

It offers the attacker 10% to return 90% by 12:38 p.m. Central time on Monday.
- [Bitcoin Core fixes an AI-found bug that could stall nodes; about 40% of public nodes still run affected versions](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-core-node-stall-bug-ai-found-fix-nov-2026): Bitcoin Core disclosed CVE-2026-117348, a bug found by an AI scan that let a peer stall a node for over a dozen seconds per message. Fixes are in 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1; about 8,800 public nodes still report affected versions.

Chainflip paused swaps, and FLIP fell about 40% at the worst point.

- [Senate passes DEATH BETS Act to ban prediction market bets on war and death](https://plainbtc.com/articles/senate-passes-death-bets-act-prediction-markets-nov-2026): The Senate passed S. 4035, the DEATH BETS Act from Sens. Adam Schiff and John Curtis, by voice vote on Nov. 19. It would ban CFTC-registered exchanges from listing event contracts tied to war, terrorism, assassination, U.S. military operations or an individual's death. It now goes to the House.

All U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.3 million that day and about $3.47 billion so far in November.

- [U.S. launches a Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto scams, with TRM Labs running its tech](https://plainbtc.com/articles/threat-disruption-center-crypto-scams-trm-labs-nov-2026): The Homeland Security Task Force, co-led by DHS and the Justice Department, launched a Threat Disruption Center on Nov. 18 to trace scam money, warn victims sooner and freeze stolen crypto. Blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs is its main private partner.
- [Report: $518 million tied to hackers, including North Korea, flowed through Sky's stablecoin swap](https://plainbtc.com/articles/sky-stablecoin-psm-north-korea-518-million-inca-nov-2026): Crypto risk firm Inca Digital traced $518 million in transactions by wallets tied to hackers and other illicit actors through Sky's stablecoin swap module, including $101.9 million linked to North Korea. It warns that the $2.7 billion USDC reserve could be frozen in one go.
- [Ledger confirms tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is checking two more in Dubai](https://plainbtc.com/articles/ledger-tampered-wallets-berlin-dubai-nov-2026): Ledger says tampered hardware wallets designed to capture recovery phrases have been confirmed in Berlin, and it is investigating two suspected units bought in Dubai. The company calls it the same incident it first disclosed in October.
- [Six senators ask Treasury to protect state-licensed stablecoin issuers before GENIUS Act rules start](https://plainbtc.com/articles/senators-genius-act-state-stablecoin-safe-harbor-nov-2026): Six senators from both parties asked Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to give state-licensed stablecoin issuers the same temporary safe harbor that federally supervised issuers get under a draft GENIUS Act rule, before the law takes effect on Jan. 18, 2027.
- [Fed minutes point to more rate hikes as bitcoin slips below $63,000](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fed-minutes-more-rate-hikes-bitcoin-below-63000-nov-2026): Minutes of the Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting, released Wednesday, show almost all officials expect further rate hikes. Bitcoin fell below $63,000 earlier in the day after Governor Christopher Waller called for a half-point increase in December.

- [Russia lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT, capped at 300,000 rubles a year](https://plainbtc.com/articles/russia-retail-investors-bitcoin-ether-usdt-300000-ruble-cap-nov-2026): A Bank of Russia rule that took effect Nov. 17 lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT through licensed intermediaries, up to 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary after a knowledge test. Big brokers T-Bank and VTB are still testing.
- [Judge acquits MIT brothers in $25 million Ethereum trading-bot case, ending the first U.S. criminal MEV prosecution](https://plainbtc.com/articles/mev-brothers-acquitted-25-million-ethereum-bots-nov-2026): A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno over a 2023 trade that took about $25 million from Ethereum trading bots in 12 seconds, ruling prosecutors failed to prove a material lie. It ends the first U.S. criminal case over an MEV exploit.
- [CFTC approves Backpack's blockchain-based derivatives exchange, opening a U.S. path for crypto perpetual futures](https://plainbtc.com/articles/cftc-approves-backpack-blockchain-derivatives-exchange-nov-2026): The CFTC approved Backpack's U.S. derivatives exchange and clearinghouse, which use blockchain to execute and settle trades, after similar approvals for tZERO. Backpack plans 24/7 leveraged crypto perpetual futures for U.S. users. No launch date yet.

New Yorkers get a smaller menu: BTC, ETH and SOL as collateral and variable rates only.

Wallet backups and PINs were not involved, but some customers already report scam calls.
- [Hackers used Optimizely to plant crypto-stealing code on 178 big websites, including Ledger](https://plainbtc.com/articles/optimizely-hack-crypto-address-swap-178-sites-nov-2026): An attacker abused a flaw in Optimizely's web-testing tool to plant code on 178 organizations' websites, including Ledger and HSBC. It swapped crypto wallet addresses for the attacker's. About $7,000 was taken before the code was removed.

SOL balances and apps stay the same, and users do not need to take any action.

- [Luxor says hackers hijacked bitcoin miners through its Commander software](https://plainbtc.com/articles/luxor-commander-hack-bitcoin-miners-hashrate-ocean-nov-2026): Attackers used Luxor's Commander fleet software to point bitcoin mining machines at the OCEAN pool on Saturday night, with reports putting the redirected power near 13 EH/s. Luxor says it patched the flaw within two hours and will pay affected clients in full.
- [Germany votes to let customs seize crypto over €100,000 when its origin is unclear](https://plainbtc.com/articles/germany-customs-crypto-seizure-100000-euros-bundestag-nov-2026): Germany's Bundestag passed a customs reform that would let officers hold crypto and other assets worth over €100,000 of doubtful origin for up to 180 days, even without a criminal case. A court must approve any final confiscation, and the states still need to consent.

Coinone says trading and wallets were not hit.

## Bahasa Indonesia

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/id/): Berita Bitcoin dan kripto dengan bahasa sederhana, ringkasan pasar, dan panduan untuk pemula, dengan fokus pada pasar AS. Diperbarui November 2026.
- [Tentang PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/id/about): Apa itu PlainBTC: berita Bitcoin dan kripto dengan bahasa sederhana untuk pemula, dengan keterbukaan yang jelas dan tanpa nasihat keuangan.
- [Keterbukaan afiliasi dan referral](https://plainbtc.com/id/disclosure): Keterbukaan afiliasi PlainBTC sesuai aturan FTC AS: versi bahasa Indonesia tidak memuat tautan referral; bukan nasihat keuangan.
- [Monero turun sekitar 11% setelah KuCoin umumkan akan delisting XMR pada 30 November](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/monero-falls-11-percent-kucoin-delists-xmr-nov-2026): Monero turun lebih dari 11% pada hari Kamis setelah KuCoin mengumumkan akan delisting XMR pada 30 November, beberapa minggu setelah MEXC melakukan hal yang sama. Pengguna KuCoin punya waktu hingga 31 Desember untuk menarik koin. Aturan Uni Eropa yang berlaku mulai Juli 2027 mendorong platform teregulasi menjauhi koin privasi.
- [Binance sebut penarikan sudah pulih sepenuhnya, empat minggu setelah peretasan senilai US$6,3 miliar](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/binance-withdrawals-fully-restored-after-6-3-billion-hack-nov-2026): Binance menyatakan penangguhan penarikan akibat peretasan 29 Oktober telah dicabut sepenuhnya, mengakhiri pembukaan kembali bertahap selama empat minggu. Beberapa jaringan masih dijeda karena pemeliharaan yang menurut bursa itu tidak berkaitan dengan serangan. Binance juga memperingatkan penipu yang menawarkan untuk "mempercepat penarikan".
- [Pendiri NovaTech diperintahkan membayar 1,37 miliar dolar AS atas skema Ponzi kripto yang menyasar keluarga Haiti](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/novatech-founders-ordered-to-pay-1-37-billion-new-york-crypto-ponzi-nov-2026): Pengadilan New York memerintahkan pendiri NovaTech, Cynthia dan Eddy Petion, membayar sekitar 1,37 miliar dolar AS atas skema Ponzi kripto yang menyasar keluarga imigran Haiti. Pasangan itu kabur dari negara dan tidak pernah menanggapi gugatan, jadi korban mungkin harus menunggu lama.
- [Zodia Custody milik Standard Chartered laporkan kebocoran data, insiden keamanan kripto ketiga pekan ini](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/zodia-custody-data-breach-cryptio-bithumb-phishing-nov-2026): Zodia Custody, kustodian kripto milik Standard Chartered, menyatakan pihak luar mengakses data kontak terbatas milik klien dan staf, tanpa transaksi tanpa izin. Ini satu dari tiga pengungkapan keamanan kripto pekan ini, bersama Cryptio dan Bithumb. Risiko utama bagi pelanggan sekarang adalah phishing.
- [RUU yang mengunci bitcoin pemerintah AS selama 20 tahun sampai ke sidang pleno DPR, tetapi waktunya sempit](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/house-strategic-bitcoin-reserve-bill-20-year-lock-floor-vote-nov-2026): RUU yang akan menjadikan Cadangan Bitcoin Strategis AS undang-undang permanen dan melarang penjualan koinnya setidaknya 20 tahun kini bisa dipungut suara di DPR. - [Rute internet palsu menipu lebih dari 1.000 lokasi penambangan bitcoin agar bekerja untuk penyerang, kata Braiins](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/braiins-hashrate-hijacking-stratum-v1-1000-mining-sites-nov-2026): Braiins mengatakan seorang penyerang membajak rute internet untuk mengirim penambang bitcoin yang memakai protokol lama Stratum V1 tanpa enkripsi ke pool palsu. Pada 20 November, lebih dari 1.000 lokasi sekaligus dialihkan, dengan daya penambangan hingga 1,9 EH/s. Braiins menyarankan beralih ke Stratum V2.
- [Bitcoin kembali di atas US$60.000 saat Thanksgiving, ETF bitcoin spot mencatat arus keluar tujuh hari berturut-turut](https://plainbtc.com/id/articles/bitcoin-back-above-60000-thanksgiving-etf-outflows-seventh-day-nov-2026): Bitcoin kembali di sekitar US$60.800 pada pagi Thanksgiving, sekitar 6% di atas titik terendah Rabu di dekat US$57.200 di Kraken. ## 日本語

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/ja/): やさしい言葉でお届けするビットコイン・暗号資産ニュース、市況まとめ、初心者向けガイド。米国市場に注目。2026年11月更新。
- [PlainBTCについて](https://plainbtc.com/ja/about): PlainBTCとは：初心者向けにやさしい言葉でビットコインと暗号資産のニュースを届ける、独立した情報サイトです。開示事項を明示し、投資助言は行いません。
- [アフィリエイト・紹介プログラムに関する開示](https://plainbtc.com/ja/disclosure): 米国FTCの基準に沿ったPlainBTCのアフィリエイト開示：日本語版には紹介リンクはありません。投資助言ではありません。
- [KuCoinが11月30日にXMRの上場廃止を発表、モネロは約11%下落](https://plainbtc.com/ja/articles/monero-falls-11-percent-kucoin-delists-xmr-nov-2026): KuCoinが11月30日にXMRを上場廃止すると発表し、モネロは木曜日に11%超下落した。MEXCも数週間前に同様の措置を取っている。KuCoinの利用者は12月31日まで出金できる。2027年7月に始まるEUの規則により、規制下のプラットフォームはプライバシーコインから離れつつある。
- [Binance、63億ドルのハッキングから4週間で出金を全面再開と発表](https://plainbtc.com/ja/articles/binance-withdrawals-fully-restored-after-6-3-billion-hack-nov-2026): Binanceは、10月29日のハッキングに伴う出金停止を完全に解除したと発表し、4週間にわたる段階的な再開が完了した。一部のネットワークはメンテナンスのため停止しているが、同社は攻撃とは無関係だとしている。「出金を早める」と持ちかける詐欺にも注意を呼びかけた。

- [코인베이스는 초보자에게 안전할까? 보호되는 것, 보호되지 않는 것, 위험을 줄이는 방법](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/is-coinbase-safe-for-beginners): 코인베이스의 안전성을 쉽게 점검합니다. 암호화폐 보관 방식, 보험 대상과 비대상, 2025년 정보 유출의 실체, 계정을 지키는 체크리스트를 담았습니다.
- [코인베이스, OCC로부터 국법 신탁은행 정식 인가 획득…무엇이 달라지나](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/coinbase-occ-national-trust-charter-nov-2026): OCC가 11월 6일 Coinbase National Trust Company를 승인하면서 코인베이스의 기관용 암호화폐 수탁 사업이 연방 은행 감독 아래 놓였습니다. 인가 범위를 정리했습니다.
- [FinCEN·연준, 트래블룰 250달러 기준 인하안 철회…3,000달러 기준은 유지](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/fincen-fed-withdraw-250-travel-rule-nov-2026): 미국 규제 당국이 국경 간 기준 금액을 250달러로 낮추고 암호화폐 관련 문구를 없애려던 2020년 제안을 철회했습니다. 무엇이 달라지고 무엇이 그대로인지 살펴봅니다.
- [비트코인, 50주 이동평균선 이탈…롱 청산 10억 달러 돌파](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/bitcoin-loses-50-week-moving-average-nov-2026): BTC가 7주간 웃돌던 선 아래, 약 7만 5,488달러 미만에서 마감했고 CoinGlass는 11억 5,000만 달러의 청산을 집계했습니다. Galaxy가 제시한 확인 구간의 의미를 살펴봅니다.
- [PNC은행, 법인 고객 대상으로 Coinbase와 USDC 결제 시범 서비스 시작](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/pnc-coinbase-usdc-payments-pilot-nov-2026): 자격을 갖춘 기업은 Coinbase Payments를 통해 이더리움 기반 USDC를 받을 수 있으며, 1:1로 자동 전환되어 PNC의 달러 예금으로 들어갑니다.
- [비트코인 주말 급등락: 엔비디아 악재에 위험자산 흔들리며 10억 달러 청산](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/bitcoin-volatility-liquidations-nov-2026): BTC가 잠시 약 7만 3,761달러까지 밀렸다가 7만 5,000달러를 되찾았습니다. 무엇이 움직임을 이끌었는지, 누가 청산됐는지, 트레이더들이 무엇을 지켜보는지 정리합니다.
- [Coinbase에서 첫 비트코인 사는 방법(미국 초보자 가이드)](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/how-to-buy-first-bitcoin-coinbase): 단계별 안내: 계정 만들기, 신원 인증, 결제 수단 추가, 소액 첫 구매, 그리고 수수료와 보안에서 유의할 점.
- [중간선거 이후: ETF 자금 유출, 더 까다로운 암호화폐 규정이 다가오나?](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/us-midterms-crypto-regulation-etf-outflows): 현물 비트코인 ETF가 6월 이후 최대 주간 순유출을 기록했습니다. 민주당이 의회를 이끌 준비를 하면서 시장은 규제 불확실성을 가격에 반영하고 있습니다.
- [비트코인 ETF vs 비트코인 구매: 미국 초보자에게 어떤 것이 합리적인가요?](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/bitcoin-etf-vs-buying-bitcoin): 현물 비트코인 ETF는 중개 계좌 내에서 가격 노출을 제공합니다. 비트코인을 구매하면 자산 자체를 얻을 수 있습니다. 미국 초보자가 양육권, 수수료, IRA, 세금을 비교하는 방법은 다음과 같습니다.
- [코인베이스 수수료 설명: 스프레드, 고급 메이커/테이커, 초보자가 실제로 지불하는 것](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/coinbase-fees-explained): 코인베이스 수수료에 대한 일반 영어 분석: 단순 매수 및 매도에 대한 변수 스프레드, 고급 메이커/테이커 계층, 코인베이스 원, 미리보기 화면에서 비용을 비교하는 방법.
- [Coinbase에서 비트코인을 은행으로 출금하는 방법 (미국 절차, 시기 및 세금)](https://plainbtc.com/ko/articles/how-to-cash-out-bitcoin-coinbase-to-bank): 미국 사용자를 위한 단계별: 비트코인을 코인베이스 현금 잔액에 판매하고, ACH 또는 즉시 출금을 통해 연결된 은행으로 인출하고, 세금 보고 기본 사항을 기록하세요.
